name: Question 5
problem:
Consider the rectangle $C$ with vertices $(-3,-1),(-1,-1),(-1,1),$ and $(-3,1),$ traversed counterclockwise. Using the flux form of Green's theorem, express the flux of the vector field
$F(x,y)=(y{x}^{2}+{y}^{3}x)\,i+(-{y}^{2}x+{y}^{4})\,j$
through $C$ as a repeated integral.

Question 5
?

Consider the rectangle C with vertices (−3,−1),(−1,−1),(−1,1), and (−3,1), traversed counterclockwise. Using the flux form of Green's theorem, express the flux of the vector field F(x,y)=(yx2+y3x)i+(−y2x+y4)j through C as a repeated integral.

a
∫−1−1∫−31(5x3+y)dydx
b
∫−3−1∫−11y3(2xy+y)dydx
c
∫−3−1∫−115y3dydx
d
∫−3−1∫−115y3(x−5)dydx
e
∫−1−1∫−315x3dydx
